tagline: Light meter and frame log for film photographers
meta_description: FilmTrail is a free Android app for film photographers: meter the light, log where each frame was shot, then put the location into your scans. Everything stays on your phone.
lead: FilmTrail meters the light and, with one tap after you release the shutter, logs where each frame was shot. When the scans come back, it puts that location into the files.
mail_subject: FilmTrail: tell me when it's out
mail_body: Hi Film Wanderer, please email me when FilmTrail is on Google Play.
notify_note: Or write to us any time:
mascot_alt: The FilmTrail quail, a hiker looking through green binoculars with a compass in hand

frames.p: Uses the phone's light sensor, the same way an incident meter reads the light falling on your subject.
l: Aperture or shutter priority, EV compensation
Per-phone calibration against a meter you trust

frames.p: Tap once right after the shutter. FilmTrail keeps the time, the GPS position and the exposure you used.
l: Hold to add a voice note
Optional small reference picture of the scene
Quick Settings tile and home screen widget

frames.p: Pick the scanned files, frame by frame, with the voice note and reference picture to remind you which is which.
l: Writes GPS into the EXIF of a copy

frames.p: Every frame on a map with a thumbnail, and your log in the formats other apps read.
l: CSV, GPX (Organic Maps, OsmAnd) and KML (Google Earth)
Backup file to move to a new phone

v_p: No account, no ads, no analytics. Rolls, frames, locations and voice notes are stored only on your phone.
points: Nothing is uploaded to a server of ours. There isn't one.
Exports and backups go only where you send them.
The map background loads from OpenFreeMap only after you agree.
Remove a frame, a roll, or everything in Settings.
faqs: Yes. FilmTrail is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.
Yes. Metering, logging and matching work without a connection. Only the map background needs the internet, and you can leave it off.
Any film camera, 35 mm or medium format. FilmTrail doesn't talk to the camera; you tap the phone after each shot.
Not for now. FilmTrail is Android only (Android 8.0 and later).
closing_p: FilmTrail is in testing. Leave your email and we'll tell you when it's on Google Play.
